title: Add: remove a discontinued item from every basket (cross-service)
prompt: When a catalog item is discontinued, remove it from every customer's basket.
done: discontinuing a catalog item publishes an integration event, and Basket.API handles it by removing that product from every customer's basket

expect.text: The Services designer has the new integration event (a message) with the fields the code gives it.
The discontinue operation has a publish interaction to that message.
Basket.API's handler for the message is modelled, subscribed to the message.
The handler's interaction with what it changes (the baskets) is modelled, as far as the model can state it.
